authority.summary: core.extension records the themes an export enables, and system.theme records which of them is default. A default theme the export does not enable is an inconsistent export.

finding.assertion: The exported default or admin theme is not enabled by the same export.

conclusion.candidate: The export appears to select a theme it does not enable.
conclusion.confirmed: The export selects a theme it does not enable.
conclusion.not_observed: Every exported theme selection names a theme the same export enables.
conclusion.unknown: The theme selection or enablement evidence was not complete enough to compare.

finding.evidence_explanation: system.theme names a theme absent from the exported core.extension theme list.
finding.human_title: An exported theme selection names a theme the export does not enable
limitations: An enabled theme in exported configuration is not proof the theme is enabled at runtime.

remediation.guidance: Enable the named theme in the exported configuration or select one the export enables.

review.authority: reviewed against the pinned default.settings.php snapshot for exported configuration semantics

scope.notes: core.extension and system.theme are Drupal 8-and-later configuration.

summary: system.theme names a default theme that is absent from the complete list of themes the same exported core.extension enables.
title: The exported default theme is not enabled by the same export
